baseline.note: Historical revision retained; all180 original IDs/titles/checkbox states unchanged after reviewed generated real-worker HTTP feature tests and red-first native request/shutdown repairs on2026-11-07. Bounded Bun equivalents, not unrestricted Laravel/live-service parity.

statusDefinitions.pending: No complete verified public Bundle equivalent at the baseline; proposals and native dependency facilities do not establish implementation.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some implementation/evidence exists, but public API/options, backend integration, semantics or required live-server evidence remain incomplete.
statusDefinitions.implemented: The explicitly described bounded Bun equivalent is implemented with evidence; not a claim of complete Laravel command/flag parity.
statusDefinitions.excluded: Literal capability is specific to PHP/Laravel or has no applicable artifact; reason and any separately implemented alternative are retained without claiming equivalence.

evidencePolicy: Reference/docs pointers establish scope/contracts only. Implementation and test pointers identify inspected baseline evidence, not proof every scenario passed in this task. SQLite/process/mock evidence never substitutes for live server or service evidence. An optional adapter remains pending rather than silently excluded just because a service is unavailable.
updatePolicy: Match items by corpus ID, not array position/line number. Keep original titles/categories and duplicate examples. Reconcile sourceLocation and baseline source hash after approved progress edits/graph regeneration. Add new Bundle ledger items separately, not to the original 180-item coverage denominator. Renaming/moving reference items can change corpus IDs and requires explicit migration mapping.

blockers.description: Backend HTTP uses the code-first Bun-native router/server with live maintenance. Generated-app typecheck, Vite readiness/HMR, `ui:build`, combined API+web `/api` proxy/lifecycle and production serving pass runtime tests on Linux; non-Linux static serving remains unavailable. Auth/reload and further integrations remain unfinished.
PostgreSQL/MariaDB live expanded migration/native-client matrix requires explicitly authorized empty disposable databases and clients; no provisioning or existing application database access.

External Redis/search/mail/broadcast/monitoring services, browser binaries, container tools and package downloads require explicit availability/authorization; local mocks alone do not prove integrations.
Reference varies by Laravel/package version; supported Bun semantics/options must be pinned and documented instead of promising unqualified parity.
